p: Avert your eyes from a woman of grace,
lest you be trapped in her snare.
Turn not to her husband to mix wine and strong drink with him,
as many have been corrupted by the beauty of the beautiful woman,
and mighty are all her fatalities
Many are the wounds of a peddler … who accustom
Many are the wounds of a peddler (Ben Sira 11:36), which in this context is referring to those who accustom
to matters of forbidden sexual relations.
Like a spark ignites a coal
like a cage full of birds,
so too,
their houses are filled with deceit
Prevent the multitudes from inside your house,
and do not bring everyone into your house
Let many be those who greet you; … reveal your secrets to one in a thousand.
Let many be those who greet you; reveal your secrets to one in a thousand.
From she who lies in your bosom guard the openings of your mouth, … Grieve not about tomorrow’s trouble,
From she who lies in your bosom guard the openings of your mouth, i.e., do not tell her everything. Grieve not about tomorrow’s trouble,
because you know not what a day may bring; … perhaps tomorrow you will no longer be,
because you know not what a day may bring; perhaps tomorrow you will no longer be,
and one will have worried about a world that is not his.
